overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick-loop for zero-allocation execution, and establishing the final ascension logic for the 5,500-tick milestone. This batch closes all remaining gaps in the core simulation loop.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Hasher
tasks.architectural_spec:
1. Define struct StateHasher with static constexpr uint64_t ComputeHash(const void* data, size_t len).
2. Use FNV-1a algorithm for speed and determinism.
3. Ensure no dynamic allocation in ComputeHash.
4. Integrate with existing TickLoop::GetState() return type.
5. Verify hash stability across 1000 iterations in unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: Hash computation completes in <100ns for 1KB data.
Zero heap allocations during hash computation.
Identical state produces identical hash across 1000 runs.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant save/load verification, reducing perceived lag.

tasks.title: Optimize Tick-Loop with Pre-allocated Event Buffers
tasks.architectural_spec:
1. Replace std::vector<Event> with std::array<Event, MAX_EVENTS> in TickLoop.
2. Implement circular buffer logic for event consumption.
3. Remove all new/delete calls in the main tick function.
4. Ensure cache-line alignment for Event struct.
5. Benchmark against previous std::vector implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Tick loop execution time reduced by >15%.
Zero heap allocations in the main tick function.
No memory leaks detected in 5,500-tick run.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother frame rates and faster simulation progression.

tasks.title: Finalize Ascension Logic for 5,500-Tick Milestone
tasks.architectural_spec:
1. Define enum class AscensionState { Active, Completed, Failed }.
2. Implement CheckAscension() to compare current tick with 5500.
3. Store final state in a static constexpr struct.
4. Ensure no string allocations in state transition.
5. Link to StateHasher for final verification.
acceptance_criteria: Final state hash matches expected value.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Clear, immediate feedback on campaign completion.
